name: js-sticky-note
description: Windows 桌面便签 - Electron 毛玻璃风格

scripts.build:ts: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.pack: npm run build:ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p=require('path'); function copyRecursiveSync(src, dest){ const exists=fs.existsSync(src); const stats=exists&&fs.statSync(src); const isDirectory=exists&&stats.isDirectory(); if(isDirectory){ if(!fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true}); fs.readdirSync(src).forEach(childItemName=>copyRecursiveSync(p.join(src,childItemName),p.join(dest,childItemName))); } else if(exists){ const parent=p.dirname(dest); if(!fs.existsSync(parent)) fs.mkdirSync(parent,{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(src,dest); } } const d='dist-app/便签-win32-x64'; if(fs.existsSync(d)) fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true}); copyRecursiveSync('node_modules/electron/dist', d); const r=p.join(d,'resources/app'); ['main.js','preload.js','popout-preload.js','index.html','howler.min.js','marked.min.js','purify.min.js','json-io.js','logger.js','overlay-logger.js','paths.js','security.js','shared-utils.js','renderer.js'].forEach(f=>fs.existsSync(f)&&copyRecursiveSync(f,p.join(r,f))); ['dist','dist-renderer','main','renderer','services','constants','styles','build'].forEach(f=>fs.existsSync(f)&&copyRecursiveSync(f,p.join(r,f))); copyRecursiveSync('package.json',p.join(r,'package.json')); if(fs.existsSync(p.join(d,'electron.exe'))){fs.renameSync(p.join(d,'electron.exe'),p.join(d,'便签.exe'));} console.log('Successfully packaged app into '+d);"
